test_title: PYST 32 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In the following question, in each option a pair of figures is given. In each pair the figure towards the left of (:) is related by some logic/rule/relation with the figure on the right of (:). Select the odd figure pair from the given alternatives.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: In each valid pair, the **positions of shapes remain same but the directions (top/bottom or arrow direction) are reversed or flipped consistently**.

Checking options:

Option 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30aaec08c9bf15e6672a89d8c2d398bf3638331e7008c11e76396857efb0fb18.png] 

Directions of arrows and circle positions are flipped 

Option 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6a97995d77543b9a66d37cead77f1363d661e7f8e084d72feeb959fce40635b.png] 

Arrow directions and shapes are systematically reversed 

Option 3: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfcd858562623b212771ed111b3ae3d9f8afbc4d9dff771ba38b9ffdc94d37e0.png] 

Shapes are inverted (top ↔ bottom) consistently 

**Option 4:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84512a541e4b4cb8ec3456ac8e12526a41b4f1ffcf799acf594d238646488e7d.png] 

The transformation is **not consistent** (shapes and directions change irregularly) 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
